narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -3.00 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 275.58-279.43 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 280.53; the first objective pays 0.85R at 275.22.
